name: sporeweb_weaver_spell_can_be_countered_by_blue
notes: CR 113.6 / 702.11b: hexproof is a static ability of a permanent and does not function while the card is a spell on the stack (Carnage Tyrant and Sphinx of the Final Word rulings: counterspells can target such a spell). Sporeweb Weaver (hexproof from blue) is cast; the opponent's blue Cancel may target the spell and counters it. Found by an FDN verifier (2026-11-06); the engine had hexproof working on the stack since 2026-10-07. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
